incidents.name: LBP hashrate reward balance inflation
incidents.notes: Flash-staged LP credit made LBP's hashrate reward accounting inflate the balance reported by LBP.balanceOf(), and the token let that unearned balance be sold straight into the LBP/USDT pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: LBP 0x88886f0fD371dfF856291bAdcEd45922bC888888 created 2026-05-07 by 0x000000000000afafb7c8aea1866f5e15b9305209, unrelated to attack sender 0xb26dfe6b6180a30e2a2d9826867cc7e06631825a; no EIP-1967 upgrade events; 610.56 BNB profit after a 5 BNB builder payment; pair 0x00e3Ea08fD8CBaD955Ec5d2292Ad637670c31524
